# ERP/WMS Acronym Quick Reference

A-Z lookup. See the linked files for fuller definitions where noted.

| Acronym | Expansion | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| ABC | ABC analysis | Classifying inventory into A/B/C tiers by business significance. |
| AGV | Automated Guided Vehicle | Self-navigating warehouse vehicle moving goods between fixed points. |
| ASN | Advance Ship Notice | Supplier's electronic heads-up that a shipment is en route, with contents/ETA. |
| BOM | Bill of Materials | List of components/quantities needed to build a finished product. |
| EDI | Electronic Data Interchange | Standardized B2B document exchange format (POs, invoices, ASNs). |
| ERP | Enterprise Resource Planning | Company-wide system of record for finance, procurement, and often inventory/orders. |
| FEFO | First-Expired-First-Out | Retrieval priority by expiration date — used for perishables. |
| FIFO | First-In-First-Out | Retrieval priority by receipt order — standard for most non-perishable goods. |
| GRN | Goods Received Note | Record confirming what was physically received against a PO/ASN. |
| JIT | Just-In-Time | Inventory strategy minimizing on-hand stock via precisely timed delivery. |
| KPI | Key Performance Indicator | A tracked operational metric (pick speed, accuracy rate, fulfillment time). |
| LIFO | Last-In-First-Out | Retrieval priority by most-recent-first — a consequence of drive-in racking. |
| MSI | Multi-Source Inventory | Adobe Commerce's own inventory model (Sources, Stocks, Source Items, Reservations). |
| OEM | Original Equipment Manufacturer | Manufacturer needing real-time component-demand visibility to adjust production. |
| OMS | Order Management System | System of record for order lifecycle across channels. |
| PO | Purchase Order | Buyer's formal request to a supplier for goods. |
| RFID | Radio-Frequency Identification | Tag-based tracking read in bulk without line-of-sight scanning. |
| SSTK | Safety Stock | Buffer inventory absorbing demand/supply variability. |
| TMS | Transportation Management System | Software managing movement of goods between locations. |
| WMS | Warehouse Management System | Software managing inventory and operations inside a warehouse. |
